sloka: अनुपायेन कर्माणि विपरीतानि यानि च ।क्रियमाणानि दुष्यन्ति हवीम्ष्यप्रयतेष्विन ॥६-१२-३१॥।।
transliteration: anupāyena karmāṇi viparītāni yāni ca ।kriyamāṇāni duṣyanti havīmṣyaprayateṣvina ॥6-12-31॥।।

translations.english: "Tasks carried out without proper plan and contrary to the right principles are spoilt like inauspicious oblations offered into sacrificial fire."
